sources.verified_angle_summary: Twaasol is co-exhibiting at Cisco’s booth during LEAP 2026 to showcase its new status as the first Cisco partner in the Middle East to achieve the Cisco Powered Services Certification for Meeting Rooms. The technology company will demonstrate how it is transforming modern workplaces through intelligent collaboration, AI-powered experiences, and managed services. The partnership highlights a strategic push to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable collaboration environments that support hybrid work transitions across Saudi Arabia and the broader MENA region. Twaasol’s achievement builds on its existing Cisco Powered Cloud Calling certification, positioning the firm as a critical regional enabler of Cisco’s enterprise communication ecosystem.
